projects.title: ForgeMind
projects.description: An AI software engineer that turns a plain-language request into GitHub, Jira, and Slack work. Claude reasons over each step, LangGraph.js routes the workflow, and Swytchcode executes external actions. The public demo runs in a sandbox with simulated integrations.

projects.title: MRStay AI
projects.description: An in-development agentic real-estate assistant: a FastAPI service routes buyer conversations to reception, property, and lead-qualification agents grounded in a ChromaDB property knowledge base, with a browser chat widget on top.

projects.title: PhishGuard AI
projects.description: A phishing-awareness and URL-security UX prototype. It demonstrates a scan flow, risk report, and animated threat map using simulated data. It does not perform live threat detection.

projects.title: Developer Portfolio
